line_items.reasoning: Q1 ex-COVID vaccine operational growth of 7.6% worldwide already exceeds the full-year 2024 guidance range of 5%-6% operational growth, putting JNJ well ahead of its own annual sales trajectory.
Adjusted diluted EPS of $2.71 in Q1 (+12.4% YoY) annualizes to ~$10.84, which exceeds the high end of the guided $10.55-$10.75 range, and the company subsequently raised full-year guidance.

The strong EPS outperformance relative to revenue growth implies margin expansion beyond the guided ~50 bps improvement, and the company's decision to raise guidance this quarter further confirms margins are tracking ahead of plan.

No specific Q1 disclosures on tax rate, net interest income, or other income deviated materially from the guided ranges of 16%-17% ETR, $450M-$550M net interest income, and $1.2B-$1.4B other income, so results appear on track.
